WebSocket protocol negotiation between client and server — ensures compatibility and graceful degradation.

The protocol uses semantic versioning — clients and servers are compatible if they share the same major version: Client Version Server Version Compatible? 1.0.0 1.0.0 ✅ Yes 1.2.0 1.0.0 ✅ Yes (same major) 2.0.0 1.0.0 ❌ No (different major)

The protocol defines these standard event types: Event Type Direction Description chat Client → Server User sends a message chat_abort Client → Server Abort an active run ping / pong Both Keepalive run_content Server → Client Delta token (streaming), or a whole message's content; message_id names the reply message it belongs to message_element / message_actions Server → Client An element or the action buttons of a reply message message_update / message_remove / action_remove Server → Client Edit a reply message already shown toast Server → Client A notice (aiui.notify), never part of the reply step_start / step_update / step_end Server → Client A step of the reply (aiui.Step): step_id, parent_id, name, step_type, start/end (epoch ms), status, input, output, token, error (1.2) run_completed Server → Client Run finished run_error Server → Client Run failed tool_call_started Server → Client Tool execution began tool_call_completed Server → Client Tool returned result reasoning Server → Client Agent reasoning/thinking
